text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- High Planning Committee to meet on May 12 to discuss final draft of ninth development plan 1997-2001.
- Prime Minister Karoui holds talks with Saudi Health Minister Shobokshi on ways to reinforce cooperation.
- Tunisia takes part in international tourism exhibit in Berlin.
- Austrian national council speaker Heinz Fisher expected on Thursday in Tunis for three-day official visit.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Zouari holds talks with PLO's political department chief Farouk Kaddoumi on Middle East peace process.
